audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0].text writes "H-28G Evolution Turrets" and wants.foe[1] writes "CH-3X Grenade stun".
audit.why: Data Dragon names are H-28 G Evolution Turret (spaced, singular) and CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade. "CH-3X" is not an ability in this kit at all and was not caught by the suspectNames pass.
audit.corrected: H-28 G Evolution Turret; CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing anywhere states how long Heimerdinger's stun is down, or how that compares to Zac's engage. breakdown.cooldowns says only "matchup-defining — His self-peel stun. Dodge it."
audit.why: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is 11s at EVERY rank, while Elastic Slingshot is 21s at rank 1. That asymmetry is the whole lane: baiting the stun and immediately re-engaging does not work, because he re-arms in half the time you do. A Zac player who knows the two numbers plays the lane completely differently from one who just knows "dodge the grenade".
audit.corrected: His E returns every 11s at any rank; your Slingshot is 21s at rank 1 — you cannot trade them one for one.

audit.whatIsWrong: The grenade is treated as a uniform stun, and Heimerdinger's passive is never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot's text for CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade: it damages an area "as well as stunning anyone directly hit and slowing surrounding units" — so only the direct hit stuns and the splash merely slows, which decides whether an engage is punished or merely inconvenienced. And Hextech Affinity grants Move Speed "while near allied towers and turrets deployed by Heimerdinger" — chasing him through his own turret grid is worse than it looks, because the grid is a speed pad for him and not for you.
audit.corrected: Only a direct grenade hit stuns; the splash only slows. His passive speeds him up inside his own turret grid.
sources: champ-data/_kits/heimerdinger.json (CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, Hextech Affinity)

audit.whatIsWrong: The poke range gap is never quantified — the text just says he "zones you off the wave".
audit.why: Hextech Micro-Rockets reach 1325 units. Zac's longest tool, Stretching Strikes, is 800. There is no range at which Zac contests the poke, which is why accepting the farm loss to a gap-close level is correct rather than merely cautious.
audit.corrected: His rockets reach 1325 — past everything you have — so the farm loss to your gap-close level is forced, not a choice.

audit.why: 50.0% over 44 games with a 4-3 content chart is consistent; no chart correction warranted on this sample.

notes:
UNVERIFIED CLAIM LEFT IN PLACE ELSEWHERE, and one I removed rather than repeated: the old spikes[0].text asserted that Heimerdinger's turret beams "shred your passive blobs" during a dive. Whether turret beams (as opposed to enemy champions) can destroy Cell Division blobs is not in Riot's ability text and I could not verify it from the kit files, so my replacement text does not repeat the claim — but it also does not assert the opposite. If it is true it is worth restating with a source; if not, it is the kind of line that talks a player out of a dive that would have worked.

See zac__gwen.json notes for the Zac derived-flag warning (Elastic Slingshot is flagged grounding/projectile in the kit library; both look like regex false positives) — it applies to this matchup too, and I wrote nothing that depends on either flag.
